definition: to look at a film on TV or at the cinema
exampleSentence: We watch a film on Friday nights.
exampleTranslation: Tối thứ Sáu chúng tôi xem phim.

definition: to look at a film; American English
exampleSentence: Let's watch a movie tonight.
exampleTranslation: Tối nay mình xem phim nhé.

definition: to watch a set of programmes with the same story
exampleSentence: I'm watching a new series.
exampleTranslation: Tôi đang xem một bộ phim mới.

definition: to watch many episodes of a series one after another
translation: cày phim, xem liền mạch nhiều tập
exampleSentence: We binge-watched the whole season.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi cày hết cả mùa phim.

definition: to switch the television off
exampleSentence: Turn off the TV and go to bed.
exampleTranslation: Tắt tivi rồi đi ngủ đi.

definition: to choose another TV station
exampleSentence: Can you change the channel?
exampleTranslation: Bạn đổi kênh giúp mình được không?

definition: to save a TV show to watch later
exampleSentence: I recorded the programme last night.
exampleTranslation: Tối qua tôi đã ghi lại chương trình đó.

definition: to hear a programme on the radio
exampleSentence: My grandfather listens to the radio every morning.
exampleTranslation: Sáng nào ông tôi cũng nghe đài.

definition: to hear an audio show from the internet
exampleSentence: I listen to a podcast on the bus.
exampleTranslation: Tôi nghe podcast trên xe buýt.

definition: to start playing music
exampleSentence: Put on some music while we cook.
exampleTranslation: Bật nhạc lên trong lúc mình nấu ăn.

definition: to make music with something like a guitar or piano
exampleSentence: Do you play an instrument?
exampleTranslation: Bạn có chơi nhạc cụ nào không?

definition: to make music with a guitar
exampleSentence: He plays the guitar in the evening.
exampleTranslation: Buổi tối bạn ấy chơi đàn ghi-ta.

definition: to play a game with playing cards
exampleSentence: We play cards after dinner.
exampleTranslation: Sau bữa tối chúng tôi chơi bài.

definition: to play a game on a board with pieces
exampleSentence: We play a board game on rainy days.
exampleTranslation: Những ngày mưa chúng tôi chơi trò chơi cờ bàn.

definition: to put the pieces of a picture puzzle together
exampleSentence: She is doing a jigsaw at the table.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy đang ghép tranh ở bàn.

definition: to fill in a word puzzle
exampleSentence: My dad does a crossword every day.
exampleTranslation: Ngày nào bố tôi cũng giải ô chữ.

definition: to read a magazine
exampleSentence: I read a magazine at the café.
exampleTranslation: Tôi đọc tạp chí ở quán cà phê.

definition: to read the news in the paper
exampleSentence: He reads the newspaper with his breakfast.
exampleTranslation: Bố đọc báo trong lúc ăn sáng.

definition: to make a picture with a pencil or pen
exampleSentence: The children draw a picture of their family.
exampleTranslation: Bọn trẻ vẽ tranh về gia đình của mình.

definition: to make a picture with paint
exampleSentence: She paints a picture on Sundays.
exampleTranslation: Chủ nhật nào cô ấy cũng vẽ tranh.

definition: to use a camera to make pictures
exampleSentence: We took photos at the park.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi chụp ảnh ở công viên.

definition: to make a scarf from wool with needles
exampleSentence: My mother is knitting a scarf for winter.
exampleTranslation: Mẹ tôi đang đan một chiếc khăn len cho mùa đông.

definition: to rest on the sofa
exampleSentence: I relax on the sofa after work.
exampleTranslation: Sau giờ làm tôi thư giãn trên ghế sofa.

definition: to rest with your feet raised
exampleSentence: Come in and put your feet up.
exampleTranslation: Vào đây gác chân nghỉ ngơi đi.

definition: to stay in bed later than usual in the morning
exampleSentence: I have a lie-in on Sundays.
exampleTranslation: Chủ nhật tôi ngủ nướng.

definition: to fall asleep for a short time without meaning to
exampleSentence: I dozed off in front of the TV.
exampleTranslation: Tôi ngủ gật trước tivi.
